Deck of Many Things.name: Baraja de muchas cosas
Deck of Many Things.description: Estas 22 cartas de vitela pesada, generalmente guardadas en una caja o bolsa, contienen imágenes o glifos que representan símbolos de poder mágico. Mirar una carta sin activarla muestra la cara de la carta pero no tiene ningún efecto mágico. Una vez que el mazo está boca abajo, las cartas se asignan al azar; si miras la carta superior varias veces, es posible que notes que cambia. Cualquier carta retirada del mazo desaparece después de unos segundos y reaparece en el mazo.

1-1.description: Balance. Tu alignment changes to a radically different one. If tú fail to adhere to that alignment, tú lose a level and all the benefits tú gained at that level. Tu XP total doesn't change when tú lose a level this way.

2-2.description: Comet. If tú alone defeat the next low-threat or harder hostile enemigo or enemies tú encounter, obtienes enough XP to reach the next level. Otherwise, obtienes no benefit.

3-3.description: Donjon. Estás imprisoned by a 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2CNqkt2s2IYkVnv6]{Cautiverio} ritual. Este uses the prison option, typically sequestering tú in a distant part of the world. Tú also lose all tu items. Cease drawing cards.

4-4.description: Dullard. Immediately reduce tu INTELLIGENCE score by [[/r {1d4+1} #Dullard Intelligence Decrease]]{1d4+1}. Puedes then draw an additional card, and the Dullard card then disappears forever.

5-5.description: Euryale (curse). A medusa's image curses tú with a permanent -1 penalización de estado to all tiradas de salvación. Este can be removed by only a deity or the Fates card. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.8ersuvNJXX00XaIQ]{Efecto: Tarjeta Euryale (Maldición)}

6-6.description: The Fates. The Fates respin the fabric of reality to save tú from any situation tú elige. Este can reverse even a past event, and puedes make the decision instantly even if the event would slay tú. Este intervention saves only tú, not anyone else affected by the event. There's no limit on how long puedes wait before using this effect.

7-7.description: Flames. A fiend becomes filled with anger, jealousy, envy, or some other reason to despise tú. Its hatred for tú doesn't cease until either it or tú is dead. It attacks tú or otherwise attempts to foil tú within [[/r 1d20 #days]]{1d20 days}. The GM determines the specifics of the fiend.

8-8.description: Fool. Tú lose [[/r 1d10*100 #XP]]{1d10*100 XP} unless tú elige to draw two more cards.

9-9.description: Gem. Gain tu choice of 25 pieces of jewelry worth 200 gp each or 50 gems worth 100 gp each.

10-10.description: Jester. Puedes either draw two more cards or gain [[/r 1d10*100 #XP]]{1d10*100 XP}. The card then disappears forever.

11-11.description: Key. Gain a magic arma of 12th level or higher. The GM determines the item and what runes it has, if any.

12-12.description: Knight. A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-npc-core.Actor.94fOoBeUT8PgTywH]{Palace Guard} arrives and swears unfailing loyalty to tú.

13-13.description: Moon. Roll [[/r {1d4} #Wishes]]{1d4} to determine how many wishes the card grants tú, which also affects the phase of the moon depicted on the card (1: crescent moon; 2: half moon; 3: gibbous moon; 4: full moon). Estos wishes each take one action to speak and have the effect of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Deseo} conjuro.

14-14.description: rogue. One NPC ally becomes filled with hatred and immediately turns against tú forever. The NPC might keep this hatred secret until an opportune moment.

15-15.description: Ruin. Tú lose all tu nonmagical possessions, including any wealth and property.

16-16.description: Skull. Debes immediately battle a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.WoICHri7raCYv1wU]{menor Death}. If slain in the battle, puedes never be revived, except by a deity.

17-17.description: Star. Gain an ability boost debes use immediately on one ability score of tu choice.

18-18.description: Sun. Gain 1,000 PX y un beneficial permanent magia objeto de 6th a 11th level, elegido por el DJ.

19-19.description: Talons. All tu magic items disappear permanently, except for the deck and any artifact of higher level than the deck.

20-20.description: Throne. Obtienes a permanent +4 bonificador de estado to DIPLOMACY checks, and tú now own a small castle in any open area tú wish. Debes elige its location within 1 hour.  @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Zb8RYgmzCI6fQE0o]{Efecto: Carta del Trono}

21-21.description: Vizier. Upon request, puedes learn the solution to any one problem or the correct answer to any one question, unless that information is obscured by a deity. Este doesn't necessarily give tú the means to act on that solution. Tienes 1 year to take the vizier's advice or lose its benefits.

22-22.description: The Void. Tu mind becomes trapped forever. Este card is fickle, but it often throws the psyche into a prison in an object on a distant plane or planet. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Deseo} or similarly powerful magic can reveal tu psyche's location, but it doesn't bring tú back. Tu comatose body continues to function. Cease drawing cards.

1-1.description: Tú spin just like the top. Estás @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido} durante 1 asalto and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} durante 1 asalto.

4-4.description: A 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i35dpZFI7jZcRoBo]{Disfraz ilusorio} makes tú look like el objetivo.

5-5.description: A statue of el objetivo, made of chocolate or candy, appears adjacent to tú.

6-6.description: Gravity reverses, sending tú and el objetivo 30 pies in the air, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado}. Tú both fall at the start of tu next turn.

7-7.description: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Leer la mente} affects el objetivo, and the top loudly recites what it discovers.

9-9.description: A fountain erupts from the top, spraying wine for 10 minutes.

10-10.description: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Cambiar de sitio} affects tú, but tú teleport through Hell.

12-12.description: Four singing skeletons appear to serenade tú and tu allies for 1 minute, granting a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de ataque, Perception checks, tiradas de salvación, and pruebas de habilidad.

13-13.description: The top flings 1 cp at tú.

15-15.description: Tú and el objetivo change places; this is a teleportation effect.

16-16.description: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Destierro} affects el objetivo, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DCQHaLrYXMI37dvW]{Paralizar} if el objetivo's on its home plane.

17-17.description: Rainbow dye explodes and covers tú for 24 hours.

18-18.description: The top creates a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Nube tóxica} centered on el objetivo.

19-19.description: A random unattended object within 60 pies of tú sprouts animal legs and follows tú, reverting when the top's activation recharges.

20-20.description: Spin again, and el objetivo also spins as though it had activated the top.

14-15.description: All el objetivo's armas animate with the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DCPsilr8wbPXxTUv]{Dancing} rune

26-29.description: Grass grows in a 60-pies cone in front of the rod, or existing grass grows at 10 × normal rate

30-30.description: El objetivo se vuelve azul, verde o morado con duracion ilimitada

32-34.description: Heavy rain falls in a 60-pies radius around tú durante 1 asalto

40-42.description: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.RQjSQVZRG497cJhX]{Esquema vibrante}, con una duracion de 1 asalto

43-44.description: The rod casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Imagen Múltiple} on tú

47-48.description: The non-living, unattended object closest to el objetivo (up to 30 cubic pies in size) turns ethereal for an unlimited duration

54-54.description: Tú turn blue, green, or purple with an unlimited duration

55-59.description: The rod casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Forma de peste} on tú, lasting [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}

60-61.description: [[/r 1d4*10 #gems]]{1d4*10 gems}, each worth 1 sp, shoot from the rod, dealing @Damage[1[piercing]]{1 daño perforante} to each criatura in a 15-pies cone

78-80.description: Roll again; el objetivo believes tú created the effect of the second roll

85-87.description: El objetivo queda cubierto de nectar, lo que lo deja @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} durante 1 asalto

98-100.description: The rod casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PjhUmyKnq6K5uDby]{Encoger} on tú, lasting 1 day

Warpwaves.name: ondas de disformidad
Warpwaves.description:
Muchos proteanos pueden someter a sus enemigos a alteraciones desorientadoras percibidas en el tiempo y el espacio creando ondas de realidad inestable en el entorno llamadas ondas warp.

Cuando una criatura falla su tirada de salvación y se ve afectada por una onda de disformidad, tira 1d8 y consulta la tabla siguiente para conocer el efecto específico en esa criatura.

A menos que se indique lo contrario, un efecto de onda de deformación dura [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} y ​​un nuevo efecto de onda de deformación niegacualquier efecto de onda de disformidad previo que ya afecte a una criatura.

2-2.description: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} and gains [[/r 4d6 #Temporary Puntos de Golpe]]{4d6 Puntos de Golpe temporales}

6-6.description: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado} (Zancada, Golpe, or Dar un paso only)

1-1.description: Energy Unleashed (evocation) Raw energy deals @Damage[2d6[untyped]] daño per conjuro rank of the surge (@Check[reflex|basic]) in a @Template[distance:10|type:burst].

2-2.description: Vitality Energy Expulsion (healing, necromancy, vitality) Vitality energy explodes outward, healing living criaturas for @Damage[1d8[healing,vitality]] Puntos de Golpe per conjuro rank of the surge in a @Template[distance:20|type:burst]. Undead criaturas instead take the same amount of @Damage[1d8[vitality]]{vitality daño}, with a @Check[will|basic].

3-3.description: Mass Siphon (transmutation) Las criaturas and objects within a @Template[distance:20|type:emanation] become nearly weightless until the end of tu next turn. Nearly weightless criaturas can CLIMB at their land Velocidad and can Leap as far upward as they could normally Leap horizontally.

4-4.description: Magical Nemesis (conjuration, teleportation) A random criatura connected to tu magic (or inimical to it) appears within 60 pies. The criatura should be of a level approximately equal to the level of an animal summoned by summon animal of the conjuro rank, although it can be of any type. The GM determines the specific criatura. The criatura is unfriendly to tú and friendly to tu apparent enemies. After 1 minute, the criatura can elige either to return where it came from or to remain. It is not summoned or a minion.

5-5.description: Monstrous Transformation (mental, morph, transmutation) Tu head and arms transform into an exaggerated imitation of a criatura connected to tu magic for 1 minute. The GM determines the criatura. Obtienes a bonificador de estado to arma and unarmed tiradas de daño equal to the conjuro rank. At the start of each of tu turns while estás transformed, debes succeed at a @Check[will] or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido} until the start of tu next turn. On a critical success, puedes elige to end the effect entirely, also losing the bonificador de estado.

6-6.description: Sudden Gale (air, evocation) Weather in a @Template[distance:40|type:emanation] is disturbed. Strong winds blow in a random direction for 1 minute. Each criatura that starts its turn in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude] or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado} (and be pushed 10 pies on a critical failure), and debes succeed at this save immediately after the surge. Any movement against the wind is difficult terrain, or greater difficult terrain while flying.

7-7.description: Tremor (earth, evocation) The earth trembles in a @Template[distance:40|type:emanation]. Each criatura on a surface must immediately succeed at a @Check[fortitude] or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}. The surface then becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute.

8-8.description: Oppressive Voice (divination, mental, nonlethal) The voice of tu muse, tu deity, an ancestor, or another appropriate entity suddenly overwhelms tu mind. Debes attempt a @Check[will|basic]. Sufres @Damage[1d4[mental]|traits:nonlethal] per conjuro rank with a basic Will save. On a failure, estás also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (aturdido 2 on a critical failure).

9-9.description: Trinket Squall (illusion) Visual illusions of objects related to tu magic fall like rain throughout a @Template[distance:40|type:burst] for 1 minute, giving concealment in the area. Las criaturas can attempt to disbelieve this illusion.

10-10.description: Antimagic Eruption (abjuration) The surge attempts to counteract a random conjuro active on tú and on each criatura within a @Template[distance:10|type:burst].

11-11.description: Mental Broadcast (detection, divination, mental) For 1 minute, everyone within 30 pies of puedes hear tu surface thoughts.

12-12.description: Verdant Clutch (conjuration, plant) Plants and vines grow from all surfaces within 20 pies, causing all criaturas in the area to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} unless they succeed at a @Check[reflex]. The Escape DC is equal to the conjuro DC.

13-13.description: Tinge of Terror (emotion, enchantment, fear, mental) All criaturas within 20 pies are affected by powerful fright. They attempt a @Check[will], becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} on a failure or asustado 2 on a critical failure.

14-14.description: Golpe up the Band (auditory, illusion) For 1 minute, estás followed by orchestral theme music tied to the emotional content of the actions estás performing. Este grants tú a +2 bonificador de estado to DIPLOMACY, INTIMIDATION, and PERFORMANCE checks, a -2 penalización de estado to DECEPTION checks, and makes certain uses of STEALTH virtually impossible. It might have other effects as the GM sees fit.

15-15.description: Life Sap (necromancy) The surge drains tu life force and strength. Quedas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}, and estás @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

16-16.description: Ablative Barrier (abjuration) Energy forms a protective barrier that ablates slowly as criaturas in the area take daño. All criaturas in a @Template[distance:40|type:burst] gain resistance to all daño equal to double the surge's conjuro rank for up to 1 minute. Siempre que a criatura applies this resistance, the resistance for all affected criaturas reduces by 1. The effect ends for all criaturas when it reduces to 0.

17-17.description: Luminous Pests (illusion, visual) Numerous tiny flying criaturas formed of bright colorful light, such as bats or hummingbirds, emerge from tú, flying in a @Template[distance:30|type:cone]. Tú and all criaturas in the cone must succeed at a @Check[will] or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} for 1 minute, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} durante 1 asalto and then dazzled for 1 minute on a critical failure.

18-18.description: Emotional Turmoil (emotion, enchantment, mental) A swirl of conflicting emotions overwhelm tú from the surging magic. For 1 minute, attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11] at the start of each of tu turns. On a success, obtienes a +2 bonificador de estado to all tiradas de ataque, tiradas de salvación, and pruebas de habilidad; on a failure, sufres a -2 penalización de estado to them instead.

19-19.description: Sudden Downpour (evocation, agua) agua cascades de above, putting out non-magico fires en un @Template[distance:10|type:burst] y attempting a counteract magico fires.

20-20.description: Spell Surge Tú immediately cast any conjuro in tu repertoire of the surge's conjuro rank or lower (or from tu prepared conjuros or innate conjuros if tú don't have a repertoire but have been forced to generate a wellspring surge). Debes elige a conjuro that takes 3 or fewer actions to cast.
